summary: A drawbar-style Buzz organ: six drawbar levels from 16 foot to 2 foot with an attack and a release. For organ pads and stabs; Neo Poly is the modern synth.
use_for: Drawbar-style organ tones from a set of footage-labelled harmonics.
quirks: Monophonic: one note at a time; notes play as written.
Hot at its defaults: 0 dBFS peak for a note; pull the drawbars down before stacking it.
Vib.Int. and Vib.Spd. exist but read "not impl. yet" and have no mapping: they are not in the manifest.
Velocity does not change its level. The drawbars sit in the machine's low-to-high order (16, 8, 5 1/3, 4, 2 2/3, 2 foot).
Closed source: names come from its own descriptions and measurements, not from code.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.how: Sets how long a note takes to rise, from about 1 ms to 9 s on an exponential scale.
parameters.sound: Short values start the note at once; long values fade it in.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.how: Sets how long a note takes to fade after the key is let go, from about 1 ms to 9 s on an exponential scale.
parameters.sound: Short values stop the note quickly; long values leave a trailing tone.

parameters.how: Sets the level of the 16-foot drawbar, the octave below the note, from 0 to 100.
parameters.sound: Adds deep weight under the note.

parameters.how: Sets the level of the 8-foot drawbar, the note's own pitch, from 0 to 100.
parameters.sound: Adds the main body of the tone.

parameters.how: Sets the level of the 5 1/3-foot drawbar, a fifth above the note, from 0 to 100.
Sets the level of the 4-foot drawbar, the octave above the note, from 0 to 100.
Sets the level of the 2 2/3-foot drawbar, an octave and a fifth above the note, from 0 to 100.
Sets the level of the 2-foot drawbar, two octaves above the note, from 0 to 100.
parameters.sound: Adds shimmer and bite at the top.
